## Problem

Principal audit residual debt is split across parallel epics. Without coordination, teams may:

- raise debt budgets to “get green”  
- duplicate hotspot/coverage work  
- treat permanent public API as dead code

## Rules

1. No debt budget growth across programs.  
2. Cross-link PRs to the owning epic.  
3. Close this issue when W0–W2 TD2 children done **or** after next quarterly debt audit supersedes TD2.
